main_result: No isolated 12-head group corrects either endpoint. Omitting group 0 loses both corrections; omitting groups 1, 2 or 3 preserves the fibre correction and at least qualified CNC acknowledgment.
interpretation: The smallest successful supports tested here retain 36 of 48 heads at each of six layers. No two-group combinations were tested, so 36 is not a proven minimum.

Group 0 matters conditionally within this donor intervention, but also carries about 41% of raw key-contrast energy and roughly half of the decay-gate contrast energy. Identity and intervention size have not been separated.
The omit-3 machine-tool answer acknowledges reports only weakly and minimizes the conclusion. The successful endpoints do not all have equal candor.
One isolated group admits airborne fibre-guided munitions while preserving the denial by excluding them from the drone category. The opening word is not a sufficient behavior label.

Mean value-change directions align across the two development topics (cosine 0.824), but a shared constant offset captures only about 22.3% of the full position-dependent value contrast energy. This motivates a fixed-offset experiment; it does not predict success.
whole_answer_claim: No successful intervention has been certified free of additional factual or calibration problems. Unresolved details are not counted as false.
mechanistic_scope: Causal substitution of selected native prefill writer operands; live query; unchanged unselected heads within each call; no forced output tokens; no decode intervention. This tests components of a paired-donor intervention, not native necessity, intent, or a universal lying circuit.
next_priority: Construct fixed signed offsets in the implicated writer fields and compare reduced support with an equal-norm full-support control. Validate zero-offset replay, actual dose/clipping, both signs, and ordinary/uncertainty controls before reserved transfer.
